page.notes: Marginal note beginning "Nec à sen" is partly unclear; the word "sententiis" is inferred from the visible letters. Faint grey marks at the lower left and the edge of the scan, and a watermark at the lower right, are not printed text and are left out. The word "rie[?]" is doubtful. "Focco-niana" has a Cyrillic-looking "o" in the scan's letter shape; the Latin letter o is used here. The catchword "niana" is the start of the next page's word "Focconiana" as printed.
